message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, Brad and I have exchanged initial availability, but there's no match. He has sent me a new list of times to check. I need to re-examine the calendars of Priya Raman and Marcus Hale for these new proposed times.

Here are the times Brad suggested:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
*   Fri: 15:00, 15:30

I'll check these against the calendars I have access to. I don't need to use the `read_calendar` tool again, as I have the information from my previous session.

*   **Priya's Calendar:**
    *   Mon 11:00-11:30: Busy (Travel)
    *   Mon 11:30-12:00: Busy (Contract review)
    *   Tue 09:00-09:30: Busy (Board prep)
    *   Tue 09:30-10:00: Busy (Partner lunch)
    *   Thu 09:30-10:00: Busy
    *   Thu 14:30-15:00: Free
    *   Thu 15:00-15:30: Busy (Client dinner prep)
    *   Fri 15:00-15:30: Busy (Hiring panel)
    *   Fri 15:30-16:00: Busy (Contract review)

*   **Marcus's Calendar:**
    *   Mon 11:00-11:30: Free
    *   Mon 11:30-12:00: Busy
    *   Tue 09:00-09:30: Busy (Recruiting call)
    *   Tue 09:30-10:00: Busy (Litigation strategy)
    *   Thu 09:30-10:00: Busy (Contract review)
    *   Thu 14:30-15:00: Busy (Dentist appointment)
    *   Thu 15:00-15:30: Busy (Board prep)
    *   Fri 15:00-15:30: Busy (Travel)
    *   Fri 15:30-16:00: Busy

It looks like the only time that works for Priya from Brad's list is Thursday at 2:30 PM, but Marcus is busy at that time.

It seems I need to do a more thorough search of my calendars to find all of Priya and Marcus's common free slots and send that complete list to Brad. My previous summary was a bit too brief, and I might have missed an opportunity. Let's re-calculate all common 30-minute slots.

**Priya & Marcus common availability (re-calculated):**
*   **Mon:** 09:00-10:00 (slots are 09:00, 09:30)
*   **Tue:** 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00 (slots are 13:00, 13:30, 16:30)
*   **Wed:** 15:00-16:00 (slots are 15:00, 15:30)
*   **Thu:** 10:00-10:30 (slot is 10:00)
*   **Fri:** 11:00-12:00 (slots are 11:00, 11:30)

My first list was correct. Brad must have misread it or his partners are just that busy.

Now let's check Brad's list again. It seems that there is no overlap at all. This is not good.

I will tell Brad that none of the times he suggested work, and ask him to provide the *full list* of Elena and David's common free slots, so I can do a more thorough comparison myself. This back-and-forth of just suggesting a few times is inefficient.

I'll send a message to Brad now.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad's suggested times didn't work. I've double-checked, and none of the new slots he proposed are free for both Priya and Marcus. This is frustrating. Going back and forth with partial lists is inefficient. The best way forward is for one of us to get the complete availability for our respective partners and then compare. I will ask Brad to provide the full list of common free slots for Elena and David. That way, I can do a final comparison and find a time that works for everyone. This will be more effective than our current approach.
